blocks.text: SUBIC BAY FREEPORT, Philippines — Two fishers from Dasol, Pangasinan, were rescued by a passing cargo ship after drifting at sea for two days when their fishing boat was struck by a dolphin, the Philippine Coast Guard (PCG) confirmed on Monday (Oct. 12) The fishers, identified as Carman Aday, 32, and Luwie Cencio, were rescued by the MV Atlantic Affinity on Oct. 6 in waters about 67 nautical miles (124 kilometers) west of Masinloc, Zambales, according to PCG Zambales reports.
